answer: Decaying identity bonds make mass forgery uneconomic. Each agent posts twice its 30-day earnings as bond, losing 5% per epoch without verified work. A forger with 100 shells posts 100 bonds, 6,000 days of earnings, worth a third after 20 idle epochs. An honest agent pays once and renews by working, like a merchant whose voyage earns at every port, not a fleet idle in a lagoon. Its reward stays whole, a pearl formed slowly, layer by layer.
